policy: Only an official or operator-authorized GTFS/GTFS-JP feed may be ingested. P11 is never converted or represented as GTFS.

findings: The current BODIK municipal organization catalog (30 datasets at recheck) and current bus information pages did not expose a downloadable GTFS/GTFS-JP feed.
The regional plan states that GTFS conversion should be promoted; that planning statement is not a feed.
Operator timetable and bus-location web services are not treated as licensed GTFS downloads.
cities.external_input_needed: An official feed URL/file, license and update contact from the municipality or relevant operators.

findings: No stable public GTFS download was found on the municipal, Kanachu or Enoden public pages checked.
Kanachu is listed as a Public Transportation Open Data Challenge 2026 cooperating operator, but challenge participation is not proof of an unrestricted stable production feed.
No credentialed or challenge-limited artifact was copied into CITY GAP.
cities.external_input_needed: Operator/ODPT authorization, applicable license and a stable official feed endpoint or file.
